abilities.name: Ogre Rage
abilities.description: Activate to increase Gall's damage by 25%, but reduce Cho's Armor by 25. passive Gall is permanently immune to Stun and Silence effects.; trait

fields.notes: Shares cooldown with Cho's Ogre Hide. Gall's Abilities can be cast without dismounting Cho. Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Gall's damage output.

abilities.description: Deal 135 damage to enemies in the area.

abilities.description: Throw a bomb that will bounce three times, dealing 126 damage to enemies.

abilities.name: Eye of Kilrogg
abilities.description: Place an eye, granting vision of a large area around it for 45 seconds. The eye can be killed by enemies with 2 Basic Attacks. Stores up to 2 charges. Eye of Kilrrogg

abilities.name: Shove
abilities.description: Nudge Cho a small distance and grant him 25% Movement Speed for 2 seconds.

talents.name: Keep Moving!
talents.description: Increases the Movement Speed bonus of Shove by 10% and its duration by 2 seconds.
_raw_fields: Increases the Movement Speed bonus of Shove by 10% and its duration by 2 seconds.

talents.name: Taskmaster
talents.description: Every time Cho is hit by a Hero Basic Attack, reduce the Cooldown of Shove by 1 second.
_raw_fields: Every time Cho is hit by a Hero Basic Attack, reduce the Cooldown of Shove by 1 second.

talents.name: We See You!
talents.description: Eye of Kilrogg's cooldown is decreased by 25 seconds, its range is increased by 33% and the number of Basic Attacks required to kill it is increased by 1.
_raw_fields: Eye of Kilrogg's cooldown is decreased by 25 seconds, its range is increased by 33% and the number of Basic Attacks required to kill it is increased by 1.

talents.name: Rising Dread
talents.description: Each bounce of Dread Orb increases its radius by 25% and damage by 15%. Activate Dread Orb before the second bounce ends to reverse the direction of the third bounce.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Dread Orb's damage.

_raw_fields: Each bounce of Dread Orb increases its radius by 25% and damage by 15%. Activate Dread Orb before the second bounce ends to reverse the direction of the third bounce.

talents.name: Runic Persistence
talents.description: Runic Blast deals an additional 180 damage over 3 seconds in an area around the detonation point.
_raw_fields: Runic Blast deals an additional 180 damage over 3 seconds in an area around the detonation point.

talents.name: Bomb's Away
talents.description: quest Damaging a Hero with Runic Blast increases its damage by 5, up to 200. After damaging 20 Heroes, the range and speed of Cho's Rune Bomb is increased by 20%.

fields.notes: Also increases the return speed, if Cho has chosen the Rollback Talent.

_raw_fields: quest Damaging a Hero with Runic Blast increases its damage by 5, up to 200. After damaging 20 Heroes, the range and speed of Cho's Rune Bomb is increased by 20%.

talents.name: Edge of Madness
talents.description: Every subsequent hit of Shadowflame against the same enemy Hero deals an additional 12% damage, to a maximum of 60%. These bonuses are lost if the Hero has not been hit for 7 seconds.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Shadowflame's damage.

_raw_fields: Every subsequent hit of Shadowflame against the same enemy Hero deals an additional 12% damage, to a maximum of 60%. These bonuses are lost if the Hero has not been hit for 7 seconds.

talents.name: Double Trouble
talents.description: quest If Shadowflame hits an enemy Hero that is afflicted by Cho's Consuming Blaze, its cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds. After hitting 20 Heroes, Shadowflame's cooldown is instead permanently reduced by 0.5 seconds.
_raw_fields: quest If Shadowflame hits an enemy Hero that is afflicted by Cho's Consuming Blaze, its cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds. After hitting 20 Heroes, Shadowflame's cooldown is instead permanently reduced by 0.5 seconds.

talents.name: Ogre Rampage
talents.description: Increase the damage bonus of Ogre Rage by 5%. Each time Gall damages enemy Heroes this bonus increases by 1% for 4 seconds, up to an additional 10% bonus damage.

fields.notes: Requires Ogre Rage to be active to gain stacks. Cho activating Ogre Hide causes Gall to instantly lose all stacks. Stacks additively with baseline damage bonus and other offensive damage modifiers.

talents.name: Twilight Frenzy
talents.description: cooldown 30 activeActivate to reduce the cooldowns of Shadowflame and Dread Orb to 2 seconds for the next 6 seconds.

fields.notes: Any Ability on cooldown when Twilight Frenzy is activated only has its cooldown changed the next time it is used. The 6 second duration of the effect triggers immediately after activation regardless. Changes the base cooldown of both Abilities and therefore stacks multiplicatively with the sum of any cooldown reduction applied to Cho'gall.
